identity: stable metadata id; folder path is not identity
rules: Each work folder has one index.yaml node; index is the node, not an extra directory listing.

Split by responsibility as needed: business, architecture, backend, frontend and uat each own nodes. Business can split into rules, journeys and acceptance; FE into draw/code; UAT into flows. Names and depth are flexible, not mandatory scaffolding.
A leaf has requirements, assertions and state. A parent keeps scope and derives progress from required children, never authored state/completion.

Extend existing nodes and preserve stable IDs, assets and evidence. New required work prevents parent done; unrelated completed branches remain intact. Scope or source changes invalidate only affected proof.
Several workflows may target the same work nodes; no duplicated business tree per run. Local workflow tracking is ignored by validation/digests and Git.
Declare semantic design/source files using node.assets with paths under own assets/. Their actual bytes contribute to node input binding.

Record output screenshots/videos in evidence assets with scope: node and paths under the primary owner assets/. Output evidence is not also declared as a semantic input, avoiding self-invalidating proof.
Source code remains in bound repositories; code/index.yaml tracks requirements, exact source references and completion.
Legacy node.yaml/node.md remains read compatibility; exactly one node file per work folder. Do not automatically migrate existing user work.
